name: Canh chua ca loc
summary: Canh chua cá lóc is field-snakehead sour soup, eaten with white rice. The Tiền Giang provincial portal calls it common in the South and names a sour-sweet taste, fish sauce, and sliced chili. It does not name a street.
origin: The South, on the Tiền Giang provincial portal, 5 Jan 2019. The portal does not place a stall in Mỹ Tho.
taste: The provincial portal says the soup smells sour-sweet, with fish sauce and sliced chili. It does not name a fruit or a herb.
howToEat: The portal says to eat it with a bowl of white rice after the day. It calls the soup sour-sweet, with fish sauce and sliced chili.
A vegetable list, a price, and an hour were not printed. The price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
